mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_status IN ('CONFIRMED','CHECKED_IN','COMPLETED')) AS confirmed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_status = 'CANCELLED_BY_HOST') AS cancelled_by_host, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_status = 'NO_SHOW') AS no_show, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_status = 'EXPIRED') AS expired, COUNT(r.response_minutes) AS responded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.response_minutes IS NOT NULL AND r.response_minutes <= #{slaMinutes}) AS responded_within_sla, COALESCE(SUM(r.response_minutes), 0) AS response_minutes_sum FROM hotel_bookings b LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(v.created_at) FROM marketplace_entity_versions v WHERE v.entity_type = 'HOTEL_BOOKING' AND v.entity_id = b.id AND v.snapshot ->> 'bookingStatus' IN ), CASE WHEN b.booking_status IN THEN b.updated_at END ) - b.created_at)) / 60 AS response_minutes ) r ON TRUE WHERE b.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND b.created_at >= #{since}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status IN ('CONFIRMED','CHECKED_IN','COMPLETED')) AS confirmed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 'CANCELLED_BY_HOST') AS cancelled_by_host, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 'NO_SHOW') AS no_show, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 'EXPIRED') AS expired, COUNT(r.response_minutes) AS responded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.response_minutes IS NOT NULL AND r.response_minutes <= #{slaMinutes}) AS responded_within_sla, COALESCE(SUM(r.response_minutes), 0) AS response_minutes_sum FROM activity_orders o LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(v.created_at) FROM marketplace_entity_versions v WHERE v.entity_type = 'ACTIVITY_ORDER' AND v.entity_id = o.id AND v.snapshot ->> 'orderStatus' IN ), CASE WHEN o.order_status IN THEN o.updated_at END ) - o.created_at)) / 60 AS response_minutes ) r ON TRUE WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.created_at >= #{since}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, AVG(r.overall_rating) AS reviewAverage FROM user_reviews r LEFT JOIN hotel_profiles h ON h.place_id = r.place_id LEFT JOIN activity_bookings a ON a.id = r.activity_booking_id WHERE r.created_at >= #{since} AND (h.organization_id = #{organizationId} OR a.host_organization_id = #{organizationId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partner_quality_snapshots ( id, organization_id, window_days, computed_at, bookings_total, bookings_confirmed, bookings_cancelled_by_host, bookings_no_show, bookings_expired, avg_response_minutes, response_within_sla_rate, host_cancellation_rate, no_show_rate, expiry_rate, review_count, review_average, badge ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{windowDays}, #{computedAt}, #{bookingsTotal}, #{bookingsConfirmed}, #{bookingsCancelledByHost}, #{bookingsNoShow}, #{bookingsExpired}, #{avgResponseMinutes}, #{responseWithinSlaRate}, #{hostCancellationRate}, #{noShowRate}, #{expiryRate}, #{reviewCount}, #{reviewAverage}, #{badge} ) ON CONFLICT (organization_id, window_days) DO UPDATE SET computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at, bookings_total = EXCLUDED.bookings_total, bookings_confirmed = EXCLUDED.bookings_confirmed, bookings_cancelled_by_host = EXCLUDED.bookings_cancelled_by_host, bookings_no_show = EXCLUDED.bookings_no_show, bookings_expired = EXCLUDED.bookings_expired, avg_response_minutes = EXCLUDED.avg_response_minutes, response_within_sla_rate = EXCLUDED.response_within_sla_rate, host_cancellation_rate = EXCLUDED.host_cancellation_rate, no_show_rate = EXCLUDED.no_show_rate, expiry_rate = EXCLUDED.expiry_rate, review_count = EXCLUDED.review_count, review_average = EXCLUDED.review_average, badge = EXCLUDED.badge
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM partner_quality_snapshots WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND window_days = #{windowDays}
